queryResults.exactSql: SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS utc_now, id, left(name, 32) AS name_prefix, tenant_id, status FROM public.clubs WHERE name ILIKE '%ACCC%' LIMIT 10;
queryResults.readOnlyProof: Single-statement SELECT; truncated name_prefix only; no email/phone
queryResults.piiHandling: name truncated to 32 chars; no member PII
queryResults.finding: ACCC club has explicit Production tenant_id=venue-prod-main (not default-tenant)

queryResults.purpose: Check tournament tenantId stamp in blob payload
queryResults.exactSql: SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS utc_now, count(*)::int AS tournament_object_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(t.value->>'tenantId','') = '')::int AS missing_tenant_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(COALESCE(t.value->>'tenantId','')) IN ('default-tenant','default'))::int AS default_tenant_stamp, count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(t.value->>'clubId','') = '')::int AS missing_club_id FROM public.club_data_v3 c CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(c.data->'tournaments','[]'::jsonb)) AS t(value);
queryResults.finding: Production cloud blob contains zero tournament objects; owner IDs cannot have cloud tenantId stamps

queryResults.purpose: Verify no team_tournament cloud row for individual tournament IDs
queryResults.exactSql: SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS utc_now, count(*)::int AS team_tournament_total_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE id::text IN ('tournament-1785921300822','tournament-1785921409840','tournament-1785921550968'))::int AS owner_id_matches FROM public.team_tournaments;
queryResults.readOnlyProof: Single-statement SELECT aggregates; id cast to text for comparison
queryResults.finding: Owner individual tournament IDs are not team_tournaments cloud rows

queryResults.purpose: Public catalog visibility of observed tournaments
queryResults.exactSql: SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS utc_now, count(*)::int AS published_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE id IN ('tournament-1785921300822','tournament-1785921409840','tournament-1785921550968'))::int AS owner_ids_visible FROM public.public_catalog_tournaments WHERE publication_state = 'published';
queryResults.readOnlyProof: Single-statement SELECT on projection table (not mutation RPC); equivalent to STABLE public_catalog_list_tournaments source
queryResults.finding: No published public catalog tournaments; owner IDs not publicly visible
